fact: The head of the DSISS said that facilities keep paper registers and report monthly into DHIS2, that all health structures have a DHIS2 account, and that completeness rose from under 30 per cent during the data retention to 80 per cent after it was lifted in January 2025.
title: Données Sanitaires: Les Acteurs Face Au Défi De Son Analyse Par Les Agents Après La Collecte
